name: Calendar Timeline Scrub
summary: The work week as an editing timeline: Pulse is a lane of per-minute ticks, and a Friday incident fades out once the Tuesday catch lands.
look: Dark editing-timeline look: day ruler, lanes for team, Pulse and customers, clip-like event blocks and an amber playhead with a time pill. Teal ticks mark the agent's work; a striped coral ghost block is the counterfactual incident.

motion.name: Speed-ramped scrub
motion.how: playhead eases fast and slow with a blur ramp, stops on downbeats

motion.name: Block growth
motion.how: scaleX from the left edge, 0.3 s back.out(1.4), on kicks

motion.name: Ghost dissolve
motion.how: Friday event desaturates and fades to 35% over 1 s as the catch lands

story: Hook: the playhead scrubs to Friday where striped customer tickets appear, 'found 3 days late' after Tuesday's deploy #2231. Reveal: the playhead rewinds to Tuesday and a new Acme Pulse lane fills with ticks. Proof: zoomed to minutes, the 09:42 tick turns into a coral flag, the card shows checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231, the human's Roll back block lands at 09:48, resolved in 6 min, and the Friday tickets are struck out. CTA: a quiet week, 'Every metric. Every minute.', and a coral Start free clip on the playhead.
adapt: Put your users' week on the ruler, give your product its own lane, and show the bad event it prevents as a fading ghost.

fit.risk: the counterfactual must read instantly; label the ghost and brackets boldly, max three lanes
